about: measure contests of 2024 in Louisiana, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

la_sos.name: Louisiana Secretary of State, official election results (the results site's workbook of each date)
la_sos.licence: no licence printed; the Louisiana Secretary of State's official election returns, public records
la_sos.note: each date marked official on the site's list of elections ('ResultsOfficial': '1'); files read by pipeline/intake/la_sos.py: 2024-03-23 (Election+Results+(03-23-2024).xlsx, sha256 e3fcba60ba5a, 343 contests); 2024-04-27 (Election+Results+(04-27-2024).xlsx, sha256 927f41e5ed4c, 128 contests); 2024-11-05 (Election+Results+(11-05-2024).xlsx, sha256 3d43ecabb2bd, 249 contests); 2024-12-07 (Election+Results+(12-07-2024).xlsx, sha256 6503bed65a89, 167 contests)

question.title: Parishwide School District, 5.15 Mills Continuation - Sb - 10 Yrs.

threshold.rule: Same test as the other millage propositions: a majority in number of the qualified electors voting on the proposition. Mark inferred because R.S. 18:1290 speaks of a tax 'levied or increased'; a renewal, continuation or in-lieu proposition asks the electors to authorize the levy of the tax for a further term, which I read as 'levying'; the page does not use the words renewal or continuation. Art. VI sec. 32 says a political subdivision 'may levy special taxes when authorized by a majority of the electors [...] who vote thereon'.
threshold.citation: La. R.S. 18:1290(A) (Election Code, Chapter 6-A, bond, debt, and tax elections)
threshold.quote: All qualified electors of the political subdivision ordering the election shall be entitled to vote in an election on the issuance of bonds, levying or increase of a tax, or the assumption of indebtedness by the political subdivision, and such bonds may be issued, such tax levied or increased, or indebtedness assumed if approved by a vote of a majority in number of the qualified electors voting on the proposition at such election as is provided in this Chapter.
threshold.matched: by the kind the source's words show (ad valorem millage proposition (renewal, continuation, in lieu, rededication or extension of an existing millage)); a renewal, continuation, in-lieu, rededication or extension asks the electors to levy the tax for a further term, read as a levy under R.S. 18:1290(A) [inferred]; no law read sets another share for it

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test of Louisiana's local questions shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (8 against 7.1 within 1 point of the threshold, and 244 against 240.7 within 1,000 votes, in 2024), so p may be low

Mark inferred because R.S. 18:1290 speaks of a tax 'levied or increased'; a renewal, continuation or in-lieu proposition asks the electors to authorize the levy of the tax for a further term, which I read as 'levying'; the page does not use the words renewal or continuation. Art. VI sec. 32 says a political subdivision 'may levy special taxes when authorized by a majority of the electors [...] who vote thereon'.
threshold.citation: La. R.S. 18:1290(A) (Election Code, Chapter 6-A, bond, debt, and tax elections)
threshold.quote: All qualified electors of the political subdivision ordering the election shall be entitled to vote in an election on the issuance of bonds, levying or increase of a tax, or the assumption of indebtedness by the political subdivision, and such bonds may be issued, such tax levied or increased, or indebtedness assumed if approved by a vote of a majority in number of the qualified electors voting on the proposition at such election as is provided in this Chapter.

question.title: Northeast Union Fire District, 10 Mills - Boc - 10 Yrs.

threshold.rule: Passes when more than half of the qualified electors voting on the proposition vote Yes (exactly half is not a majority). Applies to a tax levied or increased by any parish, municipality, school board or special district (fire, recreation, hospital, drainage, waterworks, road, communications, law enforcement and others, which R.S. 18:1282 makes 'political subdivisions' of Chapter 6-A). Parish and municipal millage increases and special taxes are also put to a majority of the electors voting thereon in the Constitution. The district acts read (R.S. 40:1506, 33:4566, 46:1065, 33:3821) give no other threshold: they repeat the majority or send to the general election law.

threshold.rule: Passes when more than half of the qualified electors voting on the proposition vote Yes (exactly half is not a majority).
